title: Savannah Guthrie's first interview since mother Nancy vanished: 'I imagine her terror'
summary: Nearly two months after Nancy Guthrie disappeared, her daughter Savannah discusses the toll on her family in an emotional interview with her Today show colleague Hoda Kotb.
